card.name: Filter pore size before micron units
card.fires_on: The digit 2 ending the number 0.22 (or a similar number) right before a length unit such as micron, μm or miles, mostly in filter instructions.

modes.label: 0.22 micron filter
modes.description: The final 2 of 0.22 in a filter pore size, just before micron or μm.
modes.example: Use of a protein sparing 0.2<<2>> micron filter is recommended.
